meta.title: re_form
meta.description: A non-formal education academy for high school students: projects, mentorship and community.

home.kicker: _ a non-formal education academy for high school students
home.title: learning by doing
home.mission: We create real settings where high school students learn by doing, discover what they are good at and build meaningful projects, supported by mentorship and a community that matters.
home.emptyUpcoming: Upcoming activities will appear here once the re_form team publishes them.
home.emptyPast: The archive of past activities will appear here.

login.title: log in
login.noAccount: Accounts are created by the re_form team. If you are in your school's core team and haven't received an invitation, get in touch.

forgot.title: reset your password
forgot.intro: We'll email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, we've sent the link. Check your spam folder too.

setPassword.title: choose a password
setPassword.intro: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.

error.title: this link is no longer valid
error.body: The link in the email has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one or contact the re_form team.

errors.invalidInput: Please fill in every field correctly.
errors.weakPassword: The password needs at least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Ask for a new link.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.deactivated: Your account has been deactivated. If that's a mistake, contact the re_form team.
auth.noProfile: Your account doesn't have a profile yet. Contact the re_form team.

workspace.title: projects
workspace.body: Your core team's board: tasks, deadlines and who does what. Coming in phase 2.

library.title: resources
library.body: The library of recordings, slides and documents. Coming in phase 3.

assessments.title: assessments
assessments.body: Quizzes and file tasks after each meeting. Coming in phase 4.

messages.title: messages
messages.body: Private messages between students and the re_form team. Coming in phase 5.

users.title: users
users.noSchools: There are no schools yet. Add them to the schools table in Supabase.

errors.invalidInput: Check the email, the name and, for students, the school.

setup.title: connect Supabase
setup.body: The Supabase environment variables are missing. Copy .env.example to .env.local, fill it in and restart the server. The steps are in the README.
